definitions.explanation: Income or profit generated from business activities or investments.

examples.japanese: {今期|こんき}の{収益|しゅうえき}は{前年比|ぜんねんひ}で10%{増加|ぞうか}した。
examples.english: This term's earnings increased by 10% compared to last year.

examples.japanese: {収益|しゅうえき}を{上|あ}げるために{新|あたら}しい{戦略|せんりゃく}を{考|かんが}えている。
examples.english: We're thinking of new strategies to increase profits.

examples.japanese: この{不動産|ふどうさん}から{毎月|まいつき}{収益|しゅうえき}が{入|はい}ってくる。
examples.english: I receive monthly income from this real estate.

examples.japanese: {収益|しゅうえき}{性|せい}の{高|たか}い{事業|じぎょう}に{投資|とうし}する。
examples.english: To invest in highly profitable businesses.
examples.notes: {収益|しゅうえき}{性|せい} = profitability

notes:
BUSINESS/FINANCIAL TERM:
{収益|しゅうえき} is a formal business term for earnings or profit.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {収益|しゅうえき}{性|せい}: Profitability
- {収益|しゅうえき}{力|りょく}: Earning power
- {収益|しゅうえき}{率|りつ}: Profit margin, rate of return
- {収益|しゅうえき}{構造|こうぞう}: Revenue structure
- {収益|しゅうえき}{源|げん}: Revenue source

BUSINESS EXPRESSIONS:
- {収益|しゅうえき}を{上|あ}げる: to increase profits
- {収益|しゅうえき}を{生|う}む: to generate profits
- {収益|しゅうえき}が{上|あ}がる: profits rise
- {収益|しゅうえき}が{下|さ}がる: profits fall

RELATED TERMS:
- {利益|りえき}: Profit (more general term)
- {売上|うりあげ}: Sales revenue
- {営業|えいぎょう}{利益|りえき}: Operating profit
- {純利益|じゅんりえき}: Net profit
- {損失|そんしつ}: Loss (opposite)

CONTEXT:
{収益|しゅうえき} is commonly used in:
- {決算|けっさん}{報告|ほうこく}: Financial reports
- {投資|とうし}: Investment discussions
- {不動産|ふどうさん}: Real estate (rental income)
